documents.label: system.yaml
documents.text:
format: ess/1
system: demo
version: v1
domains:
  - demo.core

documents.label: core.yaml
documents.text:
domain: demo.core
events:
  - name: demo.core.Fired
    fields:
      - name: value
        type: String
  - name: demo.core.Handled
commands:
  - name: demo.core.Handle
    input:
      - name: value
        type: Optional<String>
    outcomes:
      - name: done
        emits:
          - demo.core.Handled

documents.label: wiring.yaml
documents.text:
components:
  - component: worker
    owns:
      domains:
        - demo.core
    accepts:
      commands:
        - demo.core.Handle
    publishes:
      events:
        - demo.core.Fired
        - demo.core.Handled
bindings:
  - id: handle-fired
    when:
      event: demo.core.Fired
    invoke:
      command: demo.core.Handle
    mapping:
      value: event.value
    delivery: at_least_once
    on_failure: drop
